rationale: Follow-up after the first 9-block TSVC campaign showed a large A/A drift (s233 AA -7.6%, s2233 AA +5.1%). The wrappers now call the same logical-CPU-2/high-priority pinning used by the established harness; 15 complete blocks are pre-registered before observing this follow-up to reduce block-level scheduling noise. This is a methodological correction, not a favorable-result rerun; the original 9-block campaign remains unchanged.
